title: Transparent earbuds product ad
text: Clear earbuds float, spin and assemble in mid-air to show the design from every angle
idea: Tech products sell on detail. Floating, rotating shots on a clean background show the transparent shell, the drivers and the fit without a single spec slide.
why: Clean background, so the design is the hero.
Rotation shows every angle in seconds.
Easy to re-cut for launches and colour variants.
